AppDeletedData.description: The data of app.deleted: a converged change retired an application, standalone service or site. retainedMembers counts the members it kept rather than deleted; lastRelease is the release current before, when the change operated the release log.

AppDeployedData.description: The data of app.deployed: a changed production release passed its reviewed readiness and its transaction converged.

AppRestartedData.description: The data of app.restarted: a converged change rolled an application, standalone service or site to a fresh revision under a new restart stamp.

AppStoppedData.description: The data of app.stopped: a converged change took an application, standalone service or site offline.

BackupAcceptedData.description: The data of database.backup.accepted: a reviewed transaction admitted the backup as a recovery point. It grants no restore authority.

BackupCompletedData.description: The data of database.backup.completed: an archive and its authenticated receipt were verified at exact versions.

ChangeAppliedData.description: The data of change.applied: a reviewed inventory transaction converged. Every converged change has one, joined to its other events by transaction; scopes is empty for a change that only verified. actor and source are what the review asserted, not proved.

ChangeClosedData.description: The data of change.closed: a stopped change was closed by its committed close record, whether an operator closed it, abandoned its migration or a proved rollback ended it.

ChangeFailedData.description: The data of change.failed: the executor recorded that an operation failed (failed-no-effect: refused before any effect) or that its outcome is unknown (ambiguous), and the change waits for a resume or a close. Each recorded stop is one event; a stop the executor did not record publishes none.

DatabaseRestoredData.description: The data of database.restored: a reviewed restore of a backup converged, into a scratch database or a rebuilt server. database or appDatabase names the source; a member the restore did not record is null.

DatabaseVersions.description: One managed database server, never a tenant database. declaredVersion keeps the declared literal, such as a moving major tag.

DelegationDocument.description: One accepted delegation: the namespaces, hostnames, kinds and image repository a named deployer may use.

Delivery.description: One delivery of one event to one subscription in one cycle (initial, or a reviewed replay). state is pending, in-flight, acknowledged, failed, exhausted or cancelled. Delivery is at least once: a receiver deduplicates by eventId.

DeliveryAttempt.description: One attempt: recorded before the external call, finished after it. An attempt with outcome unknown may have been received.

DeliveryReceipt.description: A transport's evidence of an acknowledged attempt, of its own kind and version: a webhook's is its HTTP status.

DeliverySubscription.description: A subscription as the sender applies it: its revision, status, transport and filter, the feed position it has matched up to and its delivery count. paused names why it cannot be bound; refusedReplay the last replay it could not apply.

DeployPreview.description: application is the deployment's primary scope: the application's scope for app deploy, and the site's scope (standalone:site-NAME) for site deploy, whose hooks are empty. scopeDocuments are the canonical scope documents as opaque audit data; their bundles are outside the contract.

DeployerCredentials.description: A delegated deployer's credential bundle: its files relative to the bundle home (run with HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME there), token expiries, key ids and the earlier credentials it retired. It names no secret.

EventActionCount.description: How many of a change's operations had this action.

EventActor.description: Who a review says applied it; asserted by the client, not proved.

EventClosedScope.description: One scope of a closed change: reverted to its base, or kept at the change's revision.

EventScopeChange.description: One scope a converged change created, updated or retired.

EventScopeRevision.description: An accepted scope revision: its declaration's digest and generation.

EventSource.description: The repository, commit and CI run a change came from, each null when not recorded.

Fact.description: One reported value. sourceKind recorded is written-down state, observed is what a running provider reported; observedAt is when the source was read, never the request time; reason is set exactly when value is null.

Grant.description: A recorded viewer relationship on a hostname; not an effective-access check, and it may outlive its route.

HeadSummary.description: A checked inventory head and its open execution state; revision identifies the snapshot. It records no installed release version.

InventoryStatusReport.description: Recorded scopes and observed findings are separate; observationComplete false means findings are partial.

LifecycleEvent.description: An immutable lifecycle event. Its id is stable across retries and restarts; delivery is at least once, so a consumer may see the same id again. type names the payload in data, whose schema is: app.deployed AppDeployedData, database.backup.completed BackupCompletedData, database.backup.accepted BackupAcceptedData, change.applied ChangeAppliedData, change.failed ChangeFailedData, change.closed ChangeClosedData, app.deleted AppDeletedData, app.stopped AppStoppedData, app.restarted AppRestartedData, database.restored DatabaseRestoredData. A type is never renamed and a payload member never removed; a reader that does not know a type may skip it.

LifecycleEvidence.description: A named, digest-bound reference to recorded evidence.

LifecycleFeedEntry.description: An event and its position in the context's feed, which orders publication, not real-world causality.

LifecycleResource.description: The resource an event is about, by stable logical identity; a display name is never its only identity.

LifecycleScope.description: A scope: its kind (Platform, Application, Standalone or Publication) and name.

PlatformVersions.description: Installed, serving, host, component and database versions of one context. Recorded facts and observations are assembled by nagarectl into a snapshot; the API never runs a provider.

PreviewScope.description: configDigest is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the typed configuration only; the tag, image resource, base domain, CDN fields, namespace request and hook effects are in overrides. For a site the overrides are tag, imageResource and, when given, baseDomain.

Publication.description: An accepted artifact publication. usedBy lists the scopes whose accepted imageResource names it.

RenderedConfiguration.description: A config program's exact stdout as data. nagarectl refuses an unknown member, a digest that is not the SHA-256 of config's UTF-8 bytes, and a document from a newer Nagare minor version.

ScopeState.description: A recorded scope revision. converged means the accepted revision's execution completed; it is not a live health check.

ServingBuild.description: The binary serving this document, as GET /v1/platform/version reports it; readAt is the process start.

SiteList.description: Recorded sites from the inventory store only; liveObserved is false because no workload, DNS or certificate was inspected.

SiteSummary.description: A recorded site. state describes scope records, not workload health: converged means the accepted revision's execution completed.

SnapshotInfo.description: The observation snapshot the document was assembled from; observations are as of completedAt, not the request time.

TransactionHistory.description: Transactions newest first, each bound to its published review, with the actor and source that review records.

VersionInfo.description: The serving build and the contract versions it emits; not the version a context has installed.

info.description: The read-only admin API of one Nagare context: recorded inventory state, never live workload health. Its components are also Nagare's versioned document contract (docs/api/README.md).
